cargo nextest run --locked -p fireemu-adapter-grpc --test rest --profile pr

execution.portLifecycle: owned dynamic ports; stop the process and release the gate before completion

controls: contended stream request contains a locked write followed by an owned tail write
refusal is read from the stream and the stream is fully drained
guard remains at the pre-contention value and tail is absent
rollback releases the lock and a fresh stream write succeeds
failureRehearsal: inject incomplete stream response and classify as indeterminate
inject cleanup read failure and retain the ownership journal without DELETE
inject configuration drift before setup and stop before data mutation
cleanupRehearsal: bind updateTime from a typed readback
conditional DELETE only for the owned version
final absence readback for guard and tail
assert no owned process or gate remains

controls: nested over-boundary document is absent after refusal
failureRehearsal: inject a malformed body and ensure no document attempt is recorded as owned
inject a refusal readback failure and retain the recovery journal
inject an unexpected success and classify it as semantic mismatch rather than cleanup authority
cleanupRehearsal: read each present target and bind its updateTime
